messages:
lauren: Quick design question — the SLO slider tiny-step hint feels cramped when min and max are identical. Screenshot coming in a sec.
sam: I attempted moving the inline hint below the knob instead of above. Copy suggestion: "SLO target — higher = lower latency, higher cost". Too wordy?
anya: UX nit: when you tab to the slider, the focus ring overlaps the pool picker. If you use arrow keys to nudge and then press Enter to open pool menu the focus lands weird.
priya: A11y: we need aria-valuetext + aria-describedby for the hint. Recommend aria-valuetext="SLO 75% target" and aria-describedby="slo-hint-2039876543". Also include keyboard instruction in the hint.
devin: Backend note — if a pool swap happens mid-request we currently fall back to burst pool silently. We should expose a short transient banner in the UI that says "Fell back to burst pool due to capacity" with a link to the rollout policy.
nick: Copy question: rename "Burst" to "Burst (short-term)" to set expectations?
sam: Not a fan of parentheticals. What about a short tooltip instead: "Burst — temporary extra GPUs for traffic spikes". Keeps the label clean.
lauren: Tooltip sounds good. For mobile we should turn tooltip into inline microcopy under the control.
anya: Implementation plan: add tabindex, aria attributes, and explicit keyboard instructions. Example:
```
<input role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="75" aria-valuetext="75% SLO" aria-describedby="slo-hint-2039876543" />
```
priya: Also add hint text: "Use arrow keys to adjust by 1. Hold Shift + arrow to adjust by 10." And fix disabled state contrast — current gray fails WCAG AA.
sam: I'll update the swatches and provide contrast tokens.
lauren: Another behavior: when min == max we still render an active slider which confuses folks. Suggest greying the slider and showing inline microcopy: "Pinned: min and max equal. Set a range to enable autoscaling." with a small link action "Unlock range".
devin: We have a backend "locked_range" flag in the config — can wire the unlock action to toggle it.
nick: Request: confirm modal when unlocking (customers sometimes pin capacity for cost predictability). Modal text should mention potential cost changes.
anya: Agree — modal with a required checkbox: "I understand this may change cost" before enabling.
design-bot: design note added -> /notes/2039876543: aria suggestions, tooltip copy, unlock flow, confirm modal, transient fallback banner
lauren: Thanks all — I'll push a figma update tomorrow morning and tag you. :thumbsup:
